SPECTR v1.0.0 - Installation Instructions
===========================================

INSTALLATION:
1. Double-click "SPECTR.pkg"
2. Follow the installation prompts
3. The installer will copy SPECTR to your system folders:
   - VST3: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/SPECTR.vst3
   - AU: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/SPECTR.component

FIRST USE (IMPORTANT):
macOS will show a security warning because this plugin is not signed.

To bypass Gatekeeper:
1. Open your DAW (Logic Pro, Ableton, etc.)
2. When you first load SPECTR, macOS will block it
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security
4. Scroll down and click "Open Anyway" next to SPECTR warning
5. Confirm you want to open it

You only need to do this once per plugin format (VST3 and AU).

PLUGIN INFO:
- Version: 1.0.0
- Formats: VST3, AU
- Description: a real-time multi-source audio analyzer and visualizer: calibrated spectrum, EBU R128 loudness, true peak, stereo imaging, and a DJ-grade beat-synced waveform.

UNINSTALLATION:
To remove SPECTR:
1. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/SPECTR.vst3
2. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/SPECTR.component
3. Restart your DAW

COMPATIBILITY:
- macOS 14.6 or later recommended
- Built for your Mac architecture
